## This version includes important bug fixes and compatibility updates.
### This is an ALPHA version! Please report any issue you encounter.╰(￣w￣ｏ)
- Fixed Minecraft 1.21.0 compatibility.
- Vulkan mod compatibility.
- Supported Physics Mod.
- Supported Particular Reforged.
- Fixed particle collision bugs with Create mod (almostly?).
- Fixed rendering bugs with Minecraft's Fabulous graphics.
- Added last tick duration to the debug message.
- Other bug fixes.
